title: Umhlobo Ongagungqiyo Kwisilingo Segolide
intro: Emthunzini womprofeti omkhulu, umphefumlo othetha kakuhle nokholo wakhethwa ukuba uncedise kumsebenzi omkhulu. Lo mntu wema eqinile xa izihlwele zazigungqa, eshumayela ngokuchasene nokwaphulwa komthetho okucacileyo okwakusongela isiseko sobuThixo bodwa. Xa umprofeti ebuya ukuze abone ukuphosakala kwabantu, ukuzikhusela kwalo mntu kwakungekuko ukuziva enetyala kodwa kwakungenxa yomsebenzi noloyiko lokwahlukana. Ngubani lo mkhonzi ka-Allah ozinikeleyo?
clues: Ndakhethwa nguAllah ukuba ndenze umsebenzi ongcwele kunye nomnye, kwaye indima yam yayiyeyokuxhasa nokuvakalisa.
Ndanikwa ithuba lokuthetha ngokucacileyo, ndaza ndahamba nomthunywa ukuya kujongana nomcinezeli onamandla.
Ngexesha lohambo olunzima, umthunywa wenyuka intaba yedwa, endishiya ndijonge abantu.
Bengekho, abantu benza umfanekiso wegolide, ndaza ndabacenga ukuba bahlale bethembekile, kodwa balamkela icebiso lam.
Xa umthunywa ebuya, ezele ngumsindo nosizi, ndabanjwa, kodwa ndachaza ukuba ndoyisiwe kwaye ndisoyika ukubangela ukungavisisani phakathi kwabo.
Ndingumprofeti owayemi ecaleni kukaMoses, umntakwethu, ndisabelana ngomthwalo wakhe kwaye ndihlala ndiqinile nxamnye nokunqula izithixo.
